kill_gate: EXTRACTED VERBATIM from PROPOSAL.md section '关闭条件' (lines 49-53), which is a genuine closure section, so LIFECYCLE_SCHEMA.md 2's rule '有就照搬' applies rather than the NO_KILL_GATE_DEFINED sentinel. Three clauses, ANY of which closes the direction: (1) 'N=0/1/3 只是单调统一退化' -- if the three reset counts produce only a monotone uniform degradation; (2) 'single-pass/repeated-data 无交互' -- if the two data regimes do not interact with reset count; (3) '两轴不分离' -- if the PPL axis and the knowledge axis do not separate. PROPOSAL.md section '存活条件' adds the positive mirror ('至少满足一项': a significant reset x data-regime interaction, OR a PPL-vs-knowledge-recovery separation that widens with N or damage onset) and states that '普通统一退化或普通 null 不足以独立成篇'. CAVEAT, NOT A PATCH: all three clauses are QUALITATIVE -- no threshold, no n, no alpha. They state the right directions and are NOT yet decidable; quantifying them is part of the same 0-GPU read-out work that next_gate is waiting on. That gap is recorded rather than filled, because a number invented here would be indistinguishable from a pre-registered one to every later reader.
kill_gate_scope_note_20260815: PROPOSAL.md section '不是新方法' is a standing SCOPE constraint, not a kill clause, but it binds any future write-up: top-K block reset is the LLF / layerwise-reinitialisation family, and the claims 'cyclic prune-regrow 新方法', 'depth cycling' and '新 plasticity 机制' are explicitly forbidden. The surviving scientific question (PROPOSAL.md '存活的科学问题') is narrow: does forget-and-relearn, which works in small-data vision, still work in single-pass knowledge-dense decoder-only LM pretraining -- and if not, does the cost show up as recoverable PPL alongside persistent parametric knowledge loss that grows with reset count or data regime.

gpu_cost_estimate.why: No layer-reset / LLF run exists in this repository at any scale, so there is no measured s/step to extrapolate from, and the 2x3 design's per-cell token budget is itself unspecified (PROPOSAL.md fixes 'matched token presentations' but no token count). Quoting a total here would be invention. The repo's own 1B anchor (A04 STATUS.json measured_anchors: median 2.02 s/step at 1B on 8xH20, world_size=8 bs=16 gaccum=1) is a CONTINUE-TRAIN rate for a different arch-probe trainer and is NOT a valid anchor for 6 from-scratch-regime cells with resets; it is cited only to show an anchor was looked for and rejected.
gpu_cost_estimate.first_action: Once the read-out is written, time ONE cell (e.g. N=0, single-pass) for a few hundred steps and multiply by 6.

needs_arch: NOT_SPECIFIED -- no run has been designed yet, so the architecture cannot be fixed before the read-out is.
